```{r setup}
library(ggplot2)
source("../config/settings.R"); source("../R/utils.R"); source("../R/outlook.R")
data_dir <- Sys.getenv("DATA_DIR", "../data-store")
read_opt <- function(f) {
  p <- file.path(data_dir, f)
  if (file.exists(p)) readr::read_csv(p, show_col_types = FALSE) else NULL
}

gold     <- readr::read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "gold_daily.csv.gz"), show_col_types = FALSE)
normals  <- readr::read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "normals.csv.gz"), show_col_types = FALSE)
drought  <- readr::read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "drought_score.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
status   <- readr::read_csv(file.path(data_dir, "status.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
recent   <- read_opt("recent_conditions.csv")
attrib   <- read_opt("score_attribution.csv")
wytd     <- read_opt("precip_wytd.csv")
stations <- read.csv("../config/stations.csv", colClasses = "character")

cur_wy <- water_year(max(gold$date))
cur_col <- "#2a78d6"
band_fill <- "#e6e5e0"
ink2 <- "#52514e"
band_caption <- sprintf("Grey band: 10th to 90th percentile, %d-%d. Dashed: median. Blue: WY%d.",
                        min(settings$ref_years), max(settings$ref_years), cur_wy)

theme_tw <- theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(colour = band_fill, linewidth = 0.3),
        axis.text = element_text(colour = ink2), plot.title.position = "plot",
        plot.caption = element_text(colour = ink2, hjust = 0), legend.position = "none")

wy_axis <- scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 32, 62, 93, 124, 152, 183, 213, 244, 274, 305, 336),
  labels = c("Oct", "Nov", "Dec", "Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep"))
wy_axis_q <- scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(1, 93, 183, 274), labels = c("Oct", "Jan", "Apr", "Jul"))

lab <- function(k) stations$label[match(k, stations$station_key)]
latest <- function(k) { g <- gold[gold$station_key == k & !is.na(gold$metric), ]; g[which.max(g$date), ] }
```

```{r headline}
d <- drought[!is.na(drought$score), ]
now <- d[nrow(d), ]
```

**As of `r format(now$date, "%B %d, %Y")`:** Local Drought Score **`r round(now$score, 1)`** (`r ifelse(now$category == "None", "no drought", now$category)`), from `r now$n_components` of 4 components. Official USDM DSCI for Multnomah, Clackamas and Washington counties averages **`r round(now$usdm_dsci)`** on a 0 to 500 scale.

## Recent rain and snow

```{r recent-text, results="asis"}
if (!is.null(recent)) {
  cat(paste0("- ", describe_recent(recent, attrib, drought), collapse = "\n"), "\n")
} else cat("Recent precipitation and snow summary is not available yet.\n")
```

```{r recent-table}
if (!is.null(recent)) {
  win_lab <- c("7d" = "Precip, last 7 days", "30d" = "Precip, last 30 days", wytd = "Precip, water year to date",
               now = "Snow water equivalent", "7d_change" = "SWE change, last 7 days",
               "30d_change" = "SWE change, last 30 days")
  r <- recent[recent$window %in% names(win_lab), ]
  r <- r[order(match(r$window, names(win_lab)), r$station_key), ]
  signed <- grepl("change", r$window)
  f <- function(x, sg) ifelse(is.na(x), "", ifelse(sg, sprintf("%+.1f", x), sprintf("%.1f", x)))
  knitr::kable(data.frame(
    Measure = win_lab[r$window], Gauge = sub(" (SWE|precip)$", "", lab(r$station_key)),
    `This year (in)` = f(r$value, signed), `Median (in)` = f(r$median, signed),
    `% of median` = ifelse(signed, "", fmt_pct(r$pct_of_median)),
    Percentile = ifelse(is.na(r$pct), "", round(r$pct)),
    check.names = FALSE, row.names = NULL), align = "llrrrr")
}
```

Each value is ranked against the same dates in `r min(settings$ref_years)`-`r max(settings$ref_years)`. For SWE changes the percentile compares this year's gain or loss with typical gains or losses for the same window.

```{r attribution}
if (!is.null(attrib)) {
  lbl <- c(precip = "Precipitation (182-day)", flow = "Streamflow (28-day)", storage = "Bull Run storage", swe = "Snowpack")
  pts <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "", sprintf("%+.1f", x))
  pc <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "", round(x))
  tbl <- data.frame(Component = lbl[attrib$component],
                    Weight = ifelse(attrib$weight_now > 0, paste0(round(100 * attrib$weight_now), "%"), "off"),
                    `Pctl now` = pc(attrib$pct_now), check.names = FALSE)
  for (n in settings$recent_windows) {
    if (paste0("pct_", n, "d") %in% names(attrib)) {
      tbl[[sprintf("Pctl %dd ago", n)]] <- pc(attrib[[paste0("pct_", n, "d")]])
      tbl[[sprintf("Score pts, %dd", n)]] <- pts(attrib[[paste0("points_change_", n, "d")]])
    }
  }
  knitr::kable(tbl, align = paste0("lr", strrep("r", ncol(tbl) - 2)), row.names = FALSE)
}
```

*Score pts* is how much each component moved the Local Drought Score over the window (positive means wetter). They add up to the total change. When snowpack switches on in November, its weight comes out of the others, which can shift their points even if their percentiles hold steady. Rain shows up in precipitation and small-stream flow within days; snowpack pays off later, in spring flow and Bull Run refill through summer.

```{r wytd-precip, fig.height=3.2}
if (!is.null(wytd)) {
  ggplot(wytd, aes(doy)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = p10, ymax = p90), fill = band_fill) +
    geom_line(aes(y = p50), colour = ink2, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_line(data = wytd[!is.na(wytd$wytd), ], aes(y = wytd), colour = cur_col, linewidth = 0.8) +
    wy_axis +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "Precip since Oct 1 (in)",
         title = "Water-year-to-date precipitation, Mt. Hood SNOTEL average",
         caption = band_caption) + theme_tw
}
```

## Scorecard

```{r scorecard}
rows <- lapply(stations$station_key[stations$enabled == "TRUE" & stations$source %in% c("usgs", "nrcs", "manual")], function(k) {
  x <- latest(k)
  if (!nrow(x)) return(NULL)
  data.frame(Indicator = lab(k), Date = format(x$date, "%b %d"),
             Value = formatC(x$metric, format = "f", digits = 1, big.mark = ","),
             Unit = stations$unit[stations$station_key == k],
             `Percentile` = ifelse(is.na(x$pct), "", round(x$pct)),
             `% of median` = ifelse(is.na(x$pct_of_median), "", paste0(round(x$pct_of_median), "%")),
             check.names = FALSE)
})
knitr::kable(do.call(rbind, rows), align = "lllrrr")
```

Flow values are 28-day means; precipitation values are trailing 182-day totals with an SPI-style percentile.

## Drought score this water year

```{r drought-overlay, fig.height=3.4}
d$wy <- water_year(d$date); d$doy <- day_of_wy(d$date)
od <- d[d$wy == cur_wy, ]
od$score7 <- as.numeric(stats::filter(od$score, rep(1/7, 7), sides = 1))
bands <- data.frame(ymin = c(0, 2, 5, 10, 20), ymax = c(2, 5, 10, 20, 30),
                    cat = c("", "D3-D4", "D2", "D1", "D0"),
                    alpha = c(0.40, 0.32, 0.24, 0.16, 0.08))
bands$ylab <- c(NA, 3, 7.5, 15, 25)
ggplot(od, aes(doy, score7)) +
  geom_rect(data = bands, aes(xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, alpha = I(alpha)),
            inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "#eb6834") +
  geom_text(data = bands[-1, ], aes(x = 362, y = ylab, label = cat), inherit.aes = FALSE,
            size = 2.8, colour = ink2, hjust = 1) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 50, colour = ink2, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_line(colour = cur_col, linewidth = 0.8) + wy_axis +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), breaks = c(0, 10, 20, 30, 50, 100)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Score (percentile, 7-day mean)",
       caption = "Shaded: USDM drought category cutoffs. Dashed: 50 (typical conditions).") + theme_tw
```

## Snowpack (SWE) vs. normal

```{r swe, fig.height=3.4}
overlay <- function(keys, logy = FALSE, ylab = "") {
  g <- gold[gold$station_key %in% keys & gold$wy == cur_wy & !is.na(gold$metric), ]
  g$label <- lab(g$station_key)
  n <- normals[normals$station_key %in% keys, ]; n$label <- lab(n$station_key)
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_ribbon(data = n, aes(doy, ymin = p10, ymax = p90), fill = band_fill) +
    geom_line(data = n, aes(doy, p50), colour = ink2, linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_line(data = g, aes(doy, metric), colour = cur_col, linewidth = 0.7) +
    facet_wrap(~label, scales = "free_y", ncol = 2) +
    wy_axis_q + labs(x = NULL, y = ylab, caption = band_caption) + theme_tw
  if (logy) p <- p + scale_y_log10(labels = scales::comma)
  p
}
overlay(stations$station_key[stations$role == "score_swe"], ylab = "SWE (in)")
```
